create_onehot_transform: create a OneHot transform that one-hot encodes a PyTorch tensor to a specified output dimension
transform_tensor_onehot: transform a PyTorch tensor into a one-hot encoded tensor using the OneHot transform class
infer_output_info_onehot: infer the output shape and dtype of a OneHot transform given input shape and dtype
extend_transform_base: extend the Transform base class to implement a custom tensor transformation with transform and infer_output_info methods
review_transform_classes: review the Transform base class and OneHot subclass for tensor transformation capabilities in PyMARL
